# aimbody risk free fire max

Place the patch file for this variant here.

- Free Fire (com.dts.freefireth) uses:
  targetPath: Documents/contentcache/Compulsory/ios/gameassetbundles/
- Free Fire MAX (com.dts.freefiremax) uses the same path structure.

The file name must match the resourceFileName defined in InjectMenuView.swift.
